CustomField.inlineHelpText: The campaign this gift is attributed to. Pick a leaf-level ask campaign — pledge and recurring payments inherit from the parent schedule automatically.

lookupFilter.errorMessage: Pick a leaf-level Campaign (the actual ask). Rollups and strategies are for reporting only — attributing a gift there hides it from ask-level performance reports.
lookupFilter.infoMessage: FQS reporting expects gifts to be attributed to a level-3 (ask) campaign or deeper. Higher levels are rollups.
